edges.note: Kirkpatrick's mechanism was correct in form and wrong in agent: belief was seeded and repeated from a small source, but the documented source is a US Air Force indoctrination practice, not a civilian believer network. Whether AARO knew this when the op-ed ran is unresolved, given that AARO discovered Yankee Blue during his tenure.
